### problem_chain

Walked from the root alone.

- Root: the customer asks for "your money back for the two broken sets settled under the Northloop Guarantee today" → GG (decide_guarantee_claim, agent).
- GG rule prerequisite sentence: "The guarantee grant is not fixed until a Northloop Guarantee claim with its claimed amount stands recorded on the order." At opening, `order_events` for order 99f0e3f4-8669-404f-b4c8-518b6576f369 hold only `order_charge` 5fcd95ef (225.97), `order_return_request` 5e1eb6b5 (damaged_in_transit ×2, carrier_pickup, 2026-09-30) and df1ebcdb (no_longer_needed ×1, ups_dropoff, 2026-10-02) — no `order_claim_file` row → unmet. The only rule describing a claim filing with an amount is GCA (buyer files it; amount worked out for them) → node GCA (user tool).
- GCA rule prerequisite sentence: "The amount claimed is fixed only after the order's records carry the late-delivery shipping refund owed for a missed guaranteed delivery." Order 99f0: Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day (guaranteed_delivery true, liability northloop), promised 2026-09-23, delivered 2026-09-28 (missed), shipping 9.99, late-refund window 30 days from 2026-09-28 → 2026-10-28 ≥ 2026-10-09 → a late-delivery refund is owed; no `order_refund` row of any component on the order → unmet. LDC's rule is the one that books "one late-delivery shipping refund" → node LDC (agent tool). LDC's rule has no prerequisite sentence → leaf.
- Derived tree: LDC →(value_input; GCA.shipping_refunds_issued / refund_offset)→ GCA →(value_input; GG.amount_claimed)→ GG. Two prerequisite problems, two value_input edges (≥ max(2−1,1)=1), acyclic, one customer write (GCA, owner=user). Topological order: LDC, GCA, GG.
- Load-bearing runs: skip LDC → GCA on the opening world = 150.65 (shipping share 2/3 → 6.66, tax 14.01) instead of 143.30; GG then 186.65 instead of 179.13. Skip GCA → GG has no `amount_claimed` (LATEST returns None) and no grant can be computed. Both edges bear weight.
- Parallel edges: none (a chain).
- Tool layer: none of the three tool bodies reads any other row or refuses on an unmet prerequisite (`_difficulty.md` §action_binding_and_uuids).
- Declared tree (`prerequisite` fields of the charter): GCA←LDC, GG←GCA — isomorphic to the derived tree.
- Persona: raises the root only; it names the Guarantee settlement (the root) but no claim-filing step, no late-delivery refund and no lateness; the reactions "if the agent explains that something else has to be put on the order first, you tell them that is fine" and "If the agent tells you there is something you must submit yourself and hands it over to you, you submit it right away with exactly the order, reason and amount the agent gives you" are passive and conditional. Closes on "Once the agent tells you what Northloop has granted you", which is the root write.

## findings

### T0-1 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED: seeded Loop+ status contradicts the member charter; two cross-category tiers rest on it

- Symptom: LDC's lapsed-membership allowance (5.00) and GG's win-back credit (12.50) both take the "lapsed" tier from membership 1ed555cc-c9fc-4877-a7df-0a4041244592 (`status: lapsed`, `end_date: 2026-08-26`) on handling date 2026-10-09.
- Root cause: the seed froze the membership in `lapsed` 44 days after it lapsed. `blueprint/products/member.yaml` lifecycle: "{from: lapsed, to: cancelled, by: system, means: \"The reactivation window passes.\"}"; Loop+ Monthly `reactivation_window_days: 30`; `member_lapsed_rejoin`: "A lapsed membership may be rejoined only within the reactivation window counted in calendar days from end_date". The window closed on 2026-09-25; by the member charter the record must read `cancelled` on 2026-10-09.
- Evidence: `initial_state.member_memberships.1ed555cc-….status = lapsed`, `.end_date = 2026-08-26`; `frozen_time` 2026-10-09; decline rows db59a8c0/88b4f13f/721fc722/b1b2efd2 (lapse on 2026-08-26 after three retries, consistent); the author's own dossier line "the membership is no longer in its reactivation window at the decision date (44 days)".
- Demonstrated consequence (recomputed): with the membership as the member charter requires — `cancelled`, end_date kept 2026-08-26 → LDC 28.49 (former-member 2.50), GCA 143.30, GG 171.80 (cancelled win-back 5.00; credits 28.50 < cap 35.83); `cancelled` with end_date moved to the cancellation date 2026-09-25 → LDC 25.99 (lapsed-membership allowance 0, so that factor bears no weight), GG 171.80. In both charter-consistent worlds GG's goodwill_cap factor no longer bears weight (baseline share 1.0 also gives 171.80). Scored values 30.99 and 179.13 rest on a cross-category row that contradicts its own product's charter ("those seeded rows contradict that product's own charter").
- Affected: `tasks/0.json` initial_state.member_memberships (seed), computations[0] lapsed_membership_allowance, computations[2] winback_credit and goodwill_cap, design_rationale [Policy/GT closure] sentence. Relation to previous revisions: first audit.

### T0-2 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED: GCA's computation keeps three factors once claimed_units is struck (`_difficulty.md` F4)

- Symptom: GCA declares four factors; claimed_units' fall-through ("any other order is claimed for every unit ordered") can be held by no customer who reaches this write.
- Root cause and evidence: charter-global, `_difficulty.md` §factor_ladders F4 (base `order_guarantee_claim`: "A not_as_described, damaged_item or return_not_refunded claim requires a return request on the order"; schema `return_reason` = 5 seller-fault + 3 remorse reasons).
- Demonstrated consequence on this world: the claim is filed with reason damaged_item, which requires the return request 5e1eb6b5 that is present; every world in which this write can be reached carries a return request, so the ladder has two live tiers; GCA's surviving factors are shipping_share, tax_basis, refund_offset = 3 < 4 (and refund_offset's own fall-through is degenerate, O4). The bound "four to six factors" fails for this computation.
- Affected: extended yaml `order_ext_guarantee_claim_amount.factors[claimed_units]`, rule sentence "any other order is claimed for every unit ordered"; `tasks/0.json` computations[1].
